sloka: ततो रावणनीतायाः सीतायाः शत्रुकर्शनः ।इयेष पदमन्वेष्टुं चारणाचरिते पथि ॥५-१-१॥
transliteration: tato rāvaṇanītāyāḥ sītāyāḥ śatrukarśanaḥ ।iyeṣa padamanveṣṭuṁ cāraṇācarite pathi ॥5-1-1॥

translations.english: Hanuman, crusher of enemies resolved to find the whereabouts of Sita, carried away by Ravana. He followed the path of the Charanas, celestial bards.
